description:
Returns the counts of tender notices across the whole data set: open, urgent (deadline within 14 days), awarded and total, plus the size of the semantic search index, the embedding model name and the health of the portal links. Intended for requests where the user asks how many tenders are open overall or how large and current the tender data is. No parameters, so no filter by topic, region, CPV code or deadline: counts for a topic or region (e.g. open photovoltaic tenders per Bundesland) are the `total` and `by_bundesland` fields of a list_tenders result. Key output fields: open_count, urgent_count, awarded_count, total_count, index_size.

Example user questions: "Wie viele Ausschreibungen sind aktuell offen?"; "Wie aktuell ist die Vergabe-Datenbank?"; "Gibt es dringende Ausschreibungen mit Frist in 14 Tagen?"
name: get_tender_counts
title: Anzahl der Ausschreibungen abrufen
